group: jsonNodeReader is null – delegate to ObjectMapper

cases.expected: JsonNode representing the parsed JSON object (field "name" with value "John")
cases.description: When jsonNodeReader is null the method should obtain the JSON ObjectMapper via getObjectMapper(JSON) and return the JsonNode produced by ObjectMapper.readTree. The content is a valid JSON string.

cases.expected: JsonNode representing the parsed YAML (fields "name" and "age" with values "John" and 30)
cases.description: When jsonNodeReader is null and the requested format is YAML the method should delegate to the YAML ObjectMapper and return the parsed JsonNode.
If the underlying ObjectMapper cannot parse the supplied content (invalid JSON), the IOException should propagate out of readTree.

group: jsonNodeReader is set – use JsonNodeReader implementation

cases.description: When jsonNodeReader is non‑null the method must call jsonNodeReader.readTree(content, JSON) and return whatever JsonNode the reader provides. The mock is configured to return a JsonNode containing the field "id".

cases.expected: Mocked JsonNode with fields "id" = 123 and "active" = true
cases.description: Same as above but for YAML format. The JsonNodeReader mock should be invoked with InputFormat.YAML and return the prepared JsonNode.
If the injected JsonNodeReader throws an IOException (e.g., due to I/O error), the exception must propagate unchanged from readTree.

group: jsonNodeReader is null – edge cases with null or empty inputs

cases.expected: IOException (or JsonProcessingException) thrown by ObjectMapper.readTree due to null content
cases.description: When jsonNodeReader is null and the supplied content is null, ObjectMapper.readTree should throw an exception which propagates out of readTree.

cases.expected: IOException (or JsonProcessingException) thrown by ObjectMapper.readTree because the input string is empty
cases.description: Validate that an empty JSON string results in a parsing exception when delegating to the default ObjectMapper.

cases.expected: IOException (or JsonProcessingException) thrown by ObjectMapper.readTree due to whitespace‑only content
cases.description: Even though the format is YAML, whitespace‑only input cannot be parsed and should cause an exception that bubbles up.

cases.expected: NullPointerException thrown before delegating to ObjectMapper
cases.description: If the InputFormat argument is null, the method should fail early (NPE) because getObjectMapper(null) cannot resolve a mapper.

group: jsonNodeReader is set – edge cases with null/empty inputs and null returns

cases.expected: IOException thrown by JsonNodeReader.readTree due to null content
cases.description: When a custom JsonNodeReader is injected, passing a null content string should cause the reader to throw an IOException, which must propagate unchanged.

cases.expected: JsonNode returned by JsonNodeReader (could be null or EmptyNode depending on mock configuration)
cases.description: Test that the factory forwards an empty string to the injected JsonNodeReader; the mock is set up to return a specific JsonNode (e.g., NullNode) and the factory returns exactly that node.
When the InputFormat argument is null, the method should not invoke the JsonNodeReader and instead throw NPE (or behave consistently with the null‑format contract).

cases.expected: Mocked JsonNode representing a complex nested structure
cases.description: Ensure that the factory returns exactly the JsonNode supplied by the JsonNodeReader even when the node contains nested objects; verifies no transformation occurs.
If the injected JsonNodeReader deliberately returns null, readTree should propagate that null result rather than throwing or wrapping it.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown by getObjectMapper because the InputFormat is not supported
cases.description: When jsonNodeReader is null and an InputFormat value that the factory does not recognise (e.g., XML) is supplied, getObjectMapper should reject it and throw IllegalArgumentException, which must propagate out of readTree.

group: jsonNodeReader is set – unchecked exception propagation

cases.expected: RuntimeException (e.g., IllegalStateException) thrown by JsonNodeReader.readTree propagates unchanged
cases.description: When a custom JsonNodeReader is injected, if its readTree method throws a runtime exception (not declared in the signature), readTree must let that exception bubble up unchanged.

cases.expected: NullPointerException thrown by JsonNodeReader.readTree propagates unchanged
cases.description: Even though the method signature declares IOException, a JsonNodeReader implementation may throw a NullPointerException for a null content argument; the factory must not catch it and should let it propagate.
